text:
Maya (docs): heads-up — i'm going to reorganize the Reserved Capacity docs tonight. plan: extract all autoscale policy examples into a single 'Autoscaling' page, keep the provisioning page as a lean checklist + quickstart. opening a PR ~2pm PT. any blockers?

Sanjay (infra): ok from infra side. pls keep the eviction vs preemption guidance in a canonical spot and crosslink — it's referenced in onboarding scripts.

Kevin (runtime): i can own the runtime/config code snippets. i need the current burst_capacity + reserved_pool example converted to the new SDK snippet shape. will push a small patch.

Rachel (product): agree w/ single autoscale page. one ask: include an SLA section summary card that product teams can screenshot. small table + one-sentence guidance on fallbacks.

Maya (docs): noted @Kevin @Rachel — i'll stub the autoscale page with headings: Overview, Policy examples, SDK snippets, Sizing heuristics, Rollout considerations, SLA guidance. who wants the Terraform snippet migration?

Kevin (runtime): i can do SDK and tiny tf example but would prefer someone from infra sanity-check the Terraform naming (resource ids). @Sanjay?

Sanjay (infra): i'll do the tf naming pass. also flag: some links in the provisioning page point at old internal runbooks; i'll replace with public-facing runbook IDs. can someone grep for "eviction" and "reserved_pool" references and post them here?

Maya (docs): will run a link-audit as part of the PR. DocsBot: link-check queued.

DocsBot: link-check results: 4 external 404s, 2 internal redirect loops. see /internal/link-check/1763334444 for raw output.

Rachel (product): for the SLA card — keep it high level: commitment, effective latency targets, isolation behaviour (best-effort vs guaranteed), and escalation path. i'll draft copy after the PR is open.

Maya (docs): created draft PR: https://git.example.com/redwood/docs/pulls/2487 (WIP). PR description lists owners: @Kevin — runtime snippets, @Sanjay — terraform, @Rachel — SLA copy. please add reviewers.

Kevin (runtime): saw the PR. quick nit: in the SDK example you use `client.allocate_pool({size: 4})` — change to `client.create_reserved_pool({gpus: 4, region: "us-west-2"})` for parity with runtime API. i'll submit a tiny commit.

Maya (docs): thanks — noted. also adding a small note about fallback behavior: "if reserved pool is exhausted, requests may route to burst capacity or fallback model per routing policy" — is that accurate?

Sanjay (infra): accurate but add: "may incur higher latency and cost". also include the cluster eviction precedence table (short).

Maya (docs): will add that sentence and a one-line table. final checklist for merge: tf snippet updated, sdk snippet updated, link-check green, SLA copy added. target EOD. any objections?

Rachel (product): no objections. will add SLA copy by 4pm.

Kevin (runtime): no objections. pushing SDK patch now.

Sanjay (infra): no objections. i'll review TF tonight.

Maya (docs): great — thanks everyone :thumbsup: i'll merge once CI passes and link-check returns green. if anything blocks, ping me in this thread.
